degenerate_weak_fermion_matrix: Equal magnitude off-diagonal terms, weak diagonal zero by an independently allowed singlet+adjoint contraction. The color mass matrix remains unchanged.
inputs_scope: No other nonuniversal gauge threshold. Extra charged complex scalars take universal diagonal soft mass squared, no B-term or trilinear. Additional neutral and light-Higgs matching, including removal or matching of scalar thresholds, is an explicitly independent boundary. Flavor cutoff is not the unification scale. Common UV continuation with no extra nonuniversal thresholds is assumed.
